summary: First testing iteration for Řemeslník Pro 1.0 (Czech mobile app for tradespeople). Backend 16/16 pytest cases PASS including JWT auth, job lifecycle (create→schvaleno→odlozeno→dokonceno→finalize), totals/vícepráce computation, renew, diary entries, PDFs (quote + billing + variants) with DejaVu Czech diacritics and ?token= fallback, AI integration via emergentintegrations + claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 (material price, enhance description, generate-3-variants), and remeslnik-ai import. Frontend Expo web preview loads correctly: login → home (6 tiles) → adresar → zakazka detail → kalkulacka (11 trades) → generator → profil → import → nova-zakazka all render with full testID coverage and mobile viewport (390x844).

issues: React Native Web emits 'shadow*' style deprecation warnings (use boxShadow). Cosmetic only.

react_native_issues.issue: Version 55.0.19 vs Expo-expected ~17.0.11 — startup warning, but does not block (used only in denik photo picker). Inform main agent in case OTA Expo Go behavior differs.

action_items: Optional: address 'shadow*' deprecation by migrating shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to boxShadow on web.
Optional: align expo-image-picker version with Expo SDK (run `npx expo install expo-image-picker`) to remove the version-mismatch warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 890 lines — could be split into routers (auth, jobs, ai, pdf, import) for maintainability, but currently functional.
AI endpoints have 5–15s latency — frontend should already show ActivityIndicator (verified on /generator g-ai-enhance and ai-mat-btn).
_id is correctly excluded everywhere via projection {_id: 0} or serialize_job pop.
JWT secret loaded from env, bcrypt password_hash format $2b$… verified.
seed_data_creation: Tests created 2 jobs under admin (2026-001 finalized, 2026-002 empty) and a few TEST_*@example.cz registered users via register flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL is https://tradesmen-quotes.preview.emergentagent.com (not the one in the original review_request). Admin admin@remeslnikpro.cz / admin123 auto-seeded. After any code change run `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` because Metro can serve a stale 'Unmatched Route' for newly added screens until restart — this caused initial false-negative on /kalkulacka and /generator. Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_remeslnik.py (pytest, 16 tests, ~40 s including 2 Claude calls).
rca_of_issue: Initial run showed /kalkulacka and /generator as 'Unmatched Route' even though files existed. Root cause: Metro bundler had a stale route manifest cached from earlier hot-reload churn (multiple 'Premature close' / WatchFiles reload errors visible in /var/log/supervisor/expo.err.log). Mitigation: `sudo supervisorctl restart expo`; after restart all 6 home tiles route correctly to their screens. No code change required.
